description: Cancel a quote that has not been accepted yet, or a task that is in pending_review, confirmed, or in_progress. Cancelling an unaccepted quote is free. If payment was already made for a task, the quote fee (JPY 2,200) is non-refundable once charged — with one exception: if the operator declines a request after payment, the full amount paid, including the quote fee, is refunded. The operator follows up about any refund via the record messages.
name: migawari__cancel_task
title: Cancel a quote or task
